html: <sherpa-overlay-panel open data-heading="Filters" data-floatable data-minimisable style="block-size: 360px"><sherpa-filter-panel data-scope="view data"></sherpa-filter-panel></sherpa-overlay-panel>
use: For a page's filters in a panel: every scope the page offers, the View as a heading and each component's as an accordion of filter sections. It is the CONTENT of a `sherpa-overlay-panel`: the panel gives it its header, float, Pop, minimise and tab, and its own search, Suggest, Save group, ⋮ and count of filters applied are cloned into that header. Put it inside `sherpa-provider`; it asks for the scopes in `data-scope` and the source fills its sections.
